# Microsoft Excel

> > Microsoft Excel's cloud-based template library providing free, customizable spreadsheets for budgeting, project management, financial planning, and business operations with AI-powered Copilot assistance.

Excel Cloud offers a comprehensive collection of professionally designed templates across multiple languages and use cases. Users can create, edit, and share spreadsheets online with built-in collaboration features and AI assistance through Copilot in Excel.

## Key Topics

- Excel Templates
- Project Management
- Budget Planning
- Financial Planning
- Task Management
- Copilot in Excel
- Business Budgeting
- Personal Finance
- Gantt Charts
- Inventory Management
- Timesheet Tracking
- Data Visualization
- Collaborative Tools
- OneDrive Integration
- Free Spreadsheets
